description: Whether work in an industry at an Australian postcode is on the Department of Home Affairs' specified work lists for a second or third working holiday visa (the 88 or 179 days), for subclass 417 or 462. Checks every industry unless one is given.

industry.description: One industry to check: plantAnimalCultivation, tourismHospitality, construction, fishingPearling, treeFarmingFelling, mining, bushfireRecovery, disasterRecovery. Omit to check all.

subclass.description: The working holiday subclass the person holds.
